title: Privacy Policy
introduction: This page describes file processing, ordinary website requests and the separate services used for support and editing. Local processing does not mean that visiting a website creates no network data.
seoDescription: How FileCompresser handles selected files, browser memory, Cloudflare requests, support email and TinaCMS editor sessions. Automatic analytics is disabled.

sections.heading: Selected files stay in the browser workflow
body: The public tools read selected files into the browser tab and process them on your device. Results are created there and made available as downloads. FileCompresser has no file-upload endpoint for these tool operations and does not receive a copy of the selected file, its name or its processed output.

The browser still downloads the page, images, scripts and processing engines from the site. Those requests deliver program and website resources; they do not carry your selected file. This description concerns the reviewed application, not unrelated browser extensions, device software or external services you choose to use.

sections.heading: Temporary files, memory and downloads
body: Inputs and results remain referenced in the tab while they are in the queue. Media engines also use an in-memory working filesystem during a job. The application removes its temporary working files and releases references when a job ends or you remove results, clear the queue or close the tab. The browser controls when memory is reclaimed. This is not a secure-erasure promise.

The application does not save selected tool files to localStorage, IndexedDB, cookies or the Cache API. A file that you choose to download is saved by your browser to your chosen device location; that copy remains until you delete it. A crash, reload or closed tab can make an unsaved result unavailable.

sections.heading: Hosting and ordinary request data
body: Cloudflare delivers and protects this website. Ordinary website requests expose connection and request information, such as an IP address, requested URL, time and browser information, to the hosting service. Cloudflare may process network and security logs for delivery and abuse protection. These are separate from selected file contents.

This site does not promise a particular retention period for hosting logs. Provider handling depends on the relevant service and configuration. Read [Cloudflare’s Privacy Policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/) for its own practices. Avoid including private information in a page URL.

sections.heading: Engines, fonts and external links
body: Image workers and codecs, the FFmpeg media engine, PDF and ZIP code are served with the application. They run inside the browser. System fonts are used; the public interface does not fetch fonts from an external font service. Ordinary browser caching may retain website and engine code, rather than your selected tool files.
Guides can link to external documentation. Following a link visits another service under that service’s privacy practices. It does not authorize FileCompresser to upload your selected file.

sections.heading: Analytics and cookies
body: Automatic Cloudflare analytics/RUM is disabled for this site. No custom tool-event collector, advertising tracker or third-party analytics script is configured for the public tools. The application does not use analytics or advertising cookies.
Browser and hosting security features can have their own storage or cookie behavior. Local file processing is separate from those features and from the administrator editor described below.

sections.heading: Support email
body: The contact page opens your email application; there is no contact form or support-file upload. If you email the configured support address, the message, sender details and any attachments you choose to send pass through the email services involved, including the configured Zoho Mail service. This is separate from tool processing. Please send a problem description rather than private files.

Support-email retention depends on mailbox administration and provider settings. This page does not promise an unverified deletion schedule. Contact support to ask about a message you have sent. See [Zoho’s Privacy Policy](https://www.zoho.com/privacy.html) for its service practices.

sections.heading: Administrator editor and published content
body: Authorized editors use the separate /admin area with TinaCloud and GitHub to manage website content. Those services handle editor account details, sign-in sessions and authored website records. Their sessions may use storage, cookies and provider analytics under their own policies. Public tool users do not need an editor account.

Editorial records saved to the website repository can become public after a successful production build. Editors should not put private information in content fields. Selected files in the public tools are not sent to TinaCloud or the repository. See [Tina’s Privacy Notice](https://tina.io/privacy-notice) and [GitHub’s Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

sections.heading: Your choices
body: Remove results or clear the queue when you have finished. Close the tab when you no longer need unsaved work. Manage downloaded copies using your device’s file controls. Browser settings can restrict storage or network requests, although blocking required website resources may stop a tool from working.
For privacy questions, use the contact page. Do not include confidential file contents in an email or screenshot.

sections.heading: Children
body: This site is a general-purpose utility and is not directed at children under 13.

sections.heading: Changes to this page
body: The date above records the last factual review. A change to file handling, hosting features or support practices should be reflected here and in the affected interface before it is described as current.

sections.heading: About this document
body: This page describes the product’s technical behavior and named service roles. It is not a legal compliance certification and has not been reviewed by a qualified lawyer. Contact details, business identity and jurisdiction-specific requirements need the operator’s legal review.
